title: Ballot candidate research
description: Researches one candidate on the user's imported ballot using public record, campaign site, filings, endorsements, and prior office experience.

variables.name: contestTitle
variables.description: Title of the contest the candidate is running in.

variables.name: fecCandidateId
variables.description: Federal Election Commission candidate id; adds an FEC profile link.

surfaces: My Vision → Ballot Research → Candidate → Options (`ballot_candidate_research`)
